reviews.text: I was referred to him (Ziggy) by a friend. My sofa is only a little over a year old, but had alot of stains, spots & was just overall dirty.  I reached out to him by text, response time was great & an appointment was set only 2 days later. He came at the exact date & time that he said he would.  Was professional. Didn't make me uncomfortable at all ( just feel like I need to say this as a female having a male stranger come into your home). He just came in & did his job. Got my sofa cleaned & it took only about 45min. Now it looks how it looks when I 1st got it! I will definitely use him again if needed.
reviews.author: Tracy Washington

reviews.text: Ziggy and Caseem are very good.They cleaned my carpet so good.my carpet looks like new. I appreciate it,they get these carpets back in good shape for me. They were cleaning all the dirt very carefully and meticulously. Their work was extremely thorough. Thanks
reviews.author: Huiqin He
